name: smwmusic-windows
title: Windows 2000 - Startup
description:
The sound that plays when you turn on a computer from twenty years ago, notable for the funny oval Recycle Bin icon.

Also used in Windows Me.

I'm not sure how much use this would have in SMW other than maybe cutscene music, or the welcome screen, but hey, this song lends itself well to SMW instruments.
